description: This file contains unit tests for Redis-backed grain persistence in an Orleans-based distributed application. It verifies behaviors like initializing grains with no state, reading/writing state, handling Redis script cache, and conflict detection, specifically tailored for Redis as the persistence provider.

classes.description: Test suite for Redis grain persistence, including setup, configuration, and specific Redis-related test scenarios.

methods.description: Constructor setting up test context and Redis database connection.

methods.name: Redis_InitializeWithNoStateTest
methods.description: Checks that a grain with no persisted state initializes to default values.

methods.name: Redis_TestStaticIdentifierGrains
methods.description: Verifies that grains with static identifiers correctly store and retrieve state.

methods.name: Redis_TestRedisScriptCacheClearBeforeGrainWriteState
methods.description: Tests cache clearing for Redis scripts and verifies correct grain state after write.

methods.name: Redis_DoubleActivationETagConflictSimulation
methods.description: Simulates a conflict scenario to ensure concurrency and consistency handling.
